protocol.objective: Mean over galleries of mean preferred-versus-wrong logistic cross-entropy; sigmoid(8 * (preferredScore - alternativeScore)).
protocol.selection: Minimum validation loss with a 0.0001 improvement threshold; test trajectories computed only after checkpoint selection.

smallBatch.selection: First eight sorted baseline-misranked training galleries from distinct meaning families whose comparisons can theoretically be corrected within the existing residual bound; no validation/test examples.
smallBatch.success: All eight galleries and every preferred-versus-wrong pair rank correctly; loss need not reach zero under the bounded production score.

biasVariance.validation: fixed original validation partition for each resample
biasVariance.evaluation: fixed original test partition, gallery-weighted pairwise Brier error
biasVariance.irreducibleNoise: not identifiable from single reviewed labels

protocol.testStatus: Previously inspected regression benchmark; not a new blind generalization or personal-taste study.
protocol.deployment: Save candidate and metrics without activating it based on this reused evaluation set.

activationReason: A previously inspected regression set is not a new blind acceptance set; candidate saved for inspection.
testCurveUse: Post-hoc diagnostic only; all checkpoints selected and optimization stopped before test trajectories were calculated.
